errors.evidence: These labels and percentages do not match the figure. The left pie is for sliding-window missing-component points and the right pie is for NTC missing-component points. For example, left chart values are 37%, 0%, 18%, 16%, 17%, 6%, 3%, 3%, and right chart values are 21%, 8%, 21%, 29%, 6%, 9%, 6% (with no 10th slice).

errors.text_span: 图表中带有一个图例，其中包含颜色，并清楚地显示了直接在每个切片中显示的百分比
errors.evidence: The figure does have legends, but it shows two separate legends, one for each pie chart, and the percentages are labels on slices rather than being 'clearly shown in each slice' as a legend item.

The description does not identify the two subplots and their specific topics: (a) sliding-window missing-component predicted-point error categories and (b) NTC missing-component predicted-point error categories.
The description omits that there are two side-by-side pie charts labeled (a) and (b), each with its own legend and percentage labels inside the slices.
